integrity.claim_scope: The additive Cayley graph on traceless matrices, with rank-one square-zero differences; not multiplication Cayley graphs.
integrity.historical_priority: bounded originality comparison only; broader nilpotent-orbit Fourier theory is a residual risk.
integrity.verification: Explicit analytic proof plus independent direct small-case character enumeration.

scientific_limitations: The Fourier formula covers all dimensions and prime powers, but intermediate spectral multiplicities in matrix dimension at least three are not individually tabulated.
Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive historical priority review have not been performed.
The checker uses small prime fields; the written proof covers extension fields.
title: Sharp Fourier extrema and a Ramanujan dichotomy for rank-one nilpotent matrix Cayley graphs
